entities.name: French Revolution
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The political upheaval (1789–1799) that overthrew the French monarchy, established a republic, and culminated in Napoleon's rise to power. Inspired by Enlightenment ideals, it proclaimed the Rights of Man and transformed European politics and society.
